title.narrative: S.T.E.A.M. Education Policy for the British Virgin Islands

description.narrative: The Ministry of Education is actively engaged in the formulation of a comprehensive S.T.E.A.M. (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) policy and advice concerning STEM education, delineating the strategic integration of these disciplines into the education curriculum for students across all grade levels and specifically highlighting girls and women in STEAM education. This initiative is propelled by the recognition of the critical role S.T.E.A.M. plays in cultivating 21st-century skills among students and emphasizing the values to the fulfilment of UNESCO’s Strategy in STEM Education. In an era marked by rapid technological advancements and evolving global challenges, fostering competencies in science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics is paramount. These disciplines collectively empower students to think critically, solve complex problems, collaborate effectively, and innovate, thus equipping them with the essential skills needed to navigate and contribute to the challenges and opportunities of the contemporary world.
